description: Header file defining the AppNotificationsImplementation class, which implements app notification and configuration interfaces, manages subscribers, and handles notification dispatching within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: AppNotificationsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing app notifications and configuration interfaces, managing subscriptions, event dispatching, and notification cleanup.

classes.name: SubscriberMap
classes.description: Manages subscriber list, handles event updates, dispatches notifications, and manages app gateway references.

classes.name: ThunderSubscriptionManager
classes.description: Handles subscription and unsubscription to Thunder module events, manages registered notifications.

classes.name: SubscriberJob
classes.description: Dispatch job for subscribing or unsubscribing to notifications.

classes.name: Emitter
classes.description: Implements the IEmitter interface to emit notifications via dispatch jobs.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to an app notification event with specified context, module, and event name.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Emits a notification event with payload and app ID.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up notifications associated with a connection ID and origin.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell.
